programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning…but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right…

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson stars as a radio station owner who builds a three-dimensional television receiver which accidentally intercepts a "galaxy being" whose strange form and deadly radiation triggers a tide of panic and violence!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Hundred Days Of The Dragon
programme.desc: In a terrifyingly timely story of genetic engineering and political power plays, Sidney Blackmer stars as a popular American President who puts into place a master plan to slowly and steadily destroy the United States. James Hong also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In order to unifying the nations of Earth, a group of scientists sets out to secretly create the ultimate, global threat -- an all-powerful alien monster -- via human mutation! Robert Culp stars as the scientist chosen to undergo the transformation.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A meek, unassuming college professor (Donald Pleasence) invents a device capable of controlling the entire electro-magnetic spectrum and realizes the device has unleashed his subconscious thirst for revenge—with uncontrollable and deadly results!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Man Who Was Never Born
programme.desc: Martin Landau stars as the time-traveler Andro who is desperately trying to stop the birth of a crazed 20th century inventor whose bacterium invention turns humans into hideous mutants. Shirley Knight co-stars in this classic, touching episode.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Both a cautionary tale and a tight courtroom drama, this haunting episode explores the fear and hostility that result when all privacy is eliminated...and all secrets are revealed! Jeff Corey, Peter Breck and Alan Baxter star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: It Crawled Out Of The Woodwork
programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Dr. Phil explains to the frightened couple that this trending scam is called “virtual kidnapping,” as he instructs the audience on how to recognize these types of scammers. Then, Dr. Phil meets with Debra Newell, the real woman behind the popular podcast and hit Bravo series Dirty John. Debra was a single, successful business owner who had raised her four children when she decided she was ready to go online to try to find love. Then, Debra met John, a man who first seemed like a charming, intelligent doctor but later revealed he was emotionally abusive with a dangerous and criminal past. Detective Julia Bowman also talks about how unbeknownst to Debra, she had arrested John in 2013 for stalking and harassing an ex, and he later tried to put a hit out on the detective.

The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says she was instantly attracted to Jason, known as “Tank D.,” one of the stars of CMT’s hit show Redneck Island, and they started dating. But now, Jessica claims the man she loved for over 18 months is an arrogant, self-centered narcissist who cares more about partying and verbally trashing her than their 6-month-old baby son. Jessica says she believes this reality show "celebrity" is not only a deadbeat dad but an abusive, manipulating narcissist who is acting inappropriately with his female fans and firmly believes he cheated on her with Katie, a co-star from Redneck Island. Jason says Jessica knew he was wild from the start and failed to tame his bad boy ways. He admits he’s called Jessica names but adamantly denies he’s ever been physically abusive toward her. Jason says Jessica needs to stop using their son as a manipulative tool, because they are not together. Jason 100 percent denies cheating with Katie on season 5 of Redneck Island, but Katie says otherwise -- and in a shocking revelation, Katie reveals the full truth to Jessica. Will Jason continue to deny the affair or finally admit to cheating?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can May-December romances really last? Christopher Knight, famous for his role as Peter on The Brady Bunch, and Adrianne Curry, winner on America's Next Top Model, began their relationship when they starred together on the reality show The Surreal Life 4, and the public watched as they planned their wedding on their own show, My Fair Brady. Now they both say their 24-year age difference is a huge problem in their chaotic marriage. Adrianne says Christopher treats her like an employee, and Christopher says if she worked for him, she would’ve been fired a long time ago. Can these two work out their generational differences? Then, 38-year-old Shelly wants to know if it’s wrong to be in a relationship with an 18-year-old friend of her son. She says he makes her feel beautiful, but wonders if she’s causing him or her children harm. Dr. Phil doesn’t mince words when he tells her his opinion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Forty-year-old Sanjay is a wealthy cosmetic surgeon who met 18-year-old Jacqueline on the Web site SugarDaddie.com. They’ve only been together for four months and are already talking marriage. programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
programme.desc: Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

programme.title: Sugar Colt
programme.desc: In order to avenge a friend and to fulfill his last wish, Rocco has to find out what happened to an army corps that has mysteriously disappeared. He therefore puts on the disguise of a doctor and starts investigating in a somewhat uncomfortable town.

programme.title: Taste of Killing
programme.desc: Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: Fiery blonde half-breed Yellow Hair and her easygoing sidekick the Pecos Kid are after a fortune in Mayan gold.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: Savage Pampas
programme.desc: In the late 1800's, an army captain tries to tame the open plains of Argentina which are dominated by Indians and bandits. To help do this, the captain brings in a party of women to keep his soldiers happy.

programme.title: His Name was King
programme.desc: A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: Django Meets Sartana
programme.desc: The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: After Mitch Baker’s father is killed by gun-runners, he follows them to Mexico for revenge. In the border town of Mission, Texas, Mitch faces off with gang leader Jim Simmons, determined to take justice into his own hands, despite warnings from the sheriff.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.

programme.title: The Son of Zorro
programme.desc: In imperial Mexico, Don Ricardo Villaverde leads a double life as the masked Son of Zorro, defending the oppressed from the cruel Governor Leblanche. When rebels ambush a weapons convoy and kill Don Herrera, his daughter Conchita is saved by Zorro, sparking a daring fight against tyranny.

programme.title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
programme.desc: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a massacre in the North seeks revenge. After suffering the atrocity, the Kid executes a solo revenge, razes, beats and kills everyone involved in the massacre.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

programme.title: CBS Sports Golazo Matchnight
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: Quinn (Scott Adkins, Doctor Strange), a member of a SWAT unit, steps out of a park fountain in an Asian city with no recollection of who he is or where he came from. As he pieces together clues from his past, he vaguely recalls his young daughter, who has been kidnapped. Meanwhile, Conner (Andy On, Zombie Fight Club), a former military operative turned gangster-for-hire, discovers that his wife has also disappeared mysteriously in the middle of the night. These two men, with little in common, realize they must work together to find their loved ones and thwart their mysterious abductors.

programme.title: Jasper, Texas
programme.desc: In June of 1998, a stunning crime thrust the small town of Jasper, Texas into the glare of the media spotlight. What happened on that summer evening—the dragging death of black hitchhiker James Byrd, Jr. by three white men—would outrage the world and became a flashpoint for the state of race relations in America.

programme.title: 10th And Wolf
programme.desc: A former street tough returns to his Philadelphia home after a stint in the military. Back on his home turf, he once again finds himself tangling with the mob boss who was instrumental in his going off to be a soldier.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp
programme.desc: After a terrible boating accident killed her family, shy Angela Baker is sent to Camp Arawak. Shortly after her arrival a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.

programme.title: Unlawful Entry

It was the final elimination competition for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2003, involving fourteen fighters from across the world, with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). After his win in France, Julian needs a good result in Portugal to have a chance at the men's world title. For Jordy, Portugal is a chance to let loose and charge. For every surfer, this is the most critical point in the world tour season, as the Hawaiian leg looms on the horizon.

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

With Fujiko also after the Peking Man, will Lupin be able to add the bones to his private collection?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP44 Lion, Cheatin' And Stealin [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Sleeping Lion, a statue made of solid gold, is being transported to a museum by a specially armored, airtight car to mark the 50th anniversary of Australia's independence. Lupin steals the armored car together with the statue out from under the Sydney Police's watchful eye, but then discovers that also inside the armored car is a nearly asphyxiated Inspector Zenigata. Will Lupin choose the golden statue over Inspector Zenigata's life?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. - One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Wild Dolphins
programme.desc: In the waters surrounding New Zealand live a number of dolphin species - each of which has evolved unique strategies in their family pods to survive and thrive in the different habitats around these islands in the Pacific Ocean. On the east coast of the south island off the iconic Kaikoura peninsula, an underwater canyon pushes water seething with nutrients to the surface which provides a year round banquet for huge pods of dusky dolphins. These athletic and highly social dolphins spend their nights feeding out in the canyon, and in early morning they return closer to shore where they rest socialize and play. One of their favourite activities is the “seaweed game” where individuals pass pieces of seaweed to each other practicing fancy maneuvers where they’ll catch it on their tail, dorsal or pectoral fins. Down in the south west corner of New Zealand in the majestic landscape of Fiordland live the southern-most bottlenose dolphins. At almost 4 metres long these dolphins have adapted physically to the extreme winter conditions down here by growing bigger and fatter with extra insulating blubber and evolving stubbier beaks and shorter fins and tail flukes to reduce heat loss through their extremities. These fiords are different to the coastal environment in that freshwater sits on top of the denser seawater in a distinct layer, and is much colder than the saltwater and can prove lethal to the pods’ calves in winter, so every year the bottlenose dolphins make a short migration to the outer fiords where there is less freshwater to enable their calves to survive. Off New Zealand’s north island, in the middle of the Bay of Plenty, the country’s most active volcano erupts from the sea, sending plumes of toxic gases rising skywards. In the water surrounding this volcano roam common dolphins - the nomads of the dolphin world. They are pelagic predators which mean they roam the open ocean searching for prey.

programme.title: Eagle Queen of the Skies
programme.desc: Eagles are top predators who battle fiercely for survival and work hard to raise their young. There are 60 members of the eagle clan, all united by their acute eyesight, powerful wings, sharp talons and hooked beaks. To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programme.title: Eagle Lakes
programme.desc: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: Anaconda Wanted
programme.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial. Hardly any other animal is so feared and yet at the same time so revered as the biggest snake in the world.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programme.title: Haunted Huntress
programme.desc: A brook in the Serengeti is the home of a leopardess. The secret queen of the shadows took care of her son and has done a good job so far but the adventure continues.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Human life today would be very different if our ancestors had not stopped hunting animal protein. In the Fertile Crescent - known today as the Middle East - humans travelled in nomadic groups of hunter-gatherers and ate what they killed.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: When our ancestors saw how other animals kept warm in sub-freezing temperatures, they started hunting them for their hides and fur. As hominid evolution was diverging from other primates, they lost their thick covering of fur when the mercury dropped.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: About twelve thousand years ago, before the Neolithic Revolution, humans were mainly hunter-gatherers. Among the animals we hunted were the wild aurochs, the ancestor of all domestic cattle. The domestication of cows led to the use of oxen as draught animals that could help farmers plough fields.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Throughout history, humans have surrounded themselves with animals. But there are two species that are our undeniable favourites. Every dog today was once a wolf - genetically speaking. Wolves and hominids met as early as 400,000 years ago. Ancient hunter-gatherers and wolves competed for the same prey, and used the same tracking techniques.

programme.title: Big is beautiful
programme.desc: The world is full of giants, huge creatures that fill us with awe and wonder. Some are gentle giants. Others are deadly hunters. There are different ways of defining ‘big’ - biggest in volume, or the biggest of their kind. But one thing is for sure, the huge animals of this world are fascinating, diverse and beautiful.

programme.title: Sharks of the Icy North
programme.desc: We mostly know the nimble predators from the depths of tropical seas. At the same time very little is known about the sharks of the icy North.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: For most of our history, people have fallen victim to crippling disease, and not had a clue where it came from. Despite our best efforts, we are vulnerable - not, perhaps, to lions, tigers, and bears - but more to the killers we can’t even see. In America during the early 1980s, a mysterious new disease claims the lives of 159 people, most of them gay men.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: As a species, we believe we are more than just animals. We are inspired to express ourselves through words, art, music, and scientific endeavours. Our ancestors painted animals on cave walls - usually large mammals, like bison and deer. Animals were out first artistic subject, our first inspiration.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe's history has many dark sides, but its culture is more than a small gleam of hope, it radiates in many areas far out into the world. The old continent sets standards in art, literature and science. Starting with the ancient Greeks, Europe produces a number of smart and creative minds: from Aristotle to Michelangelo and Einstein, from Beethoven to the Beatles.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has been a battle concept for centuries: it often takes foreign enemies to weld the Europeans together. But for centuries, they are primarily fighting against themselves. It was not until the Enlightenment and the French Revolution of 1789 that a new idea of Europe emerged based on common values: freedom, equality and fraternalism.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has never experienced such a long period of peace and prosperity as after the Second World War. When the Iron Curtain falls in 1989, the dream of a Europe united in peace and freedom seems finally to become reality. But whether financial or refugee crisis - the European euphoria has disappeared, nationalists are on the rise again.

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It’s the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there’s more than just the act - it’s the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal’s purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Keppel
programme.desc: An abandoned car is discovered in a quiet Hamilton street. Police are called and they find an envelope with money in it, an IOU note and a suitcase with women’s clothing in it. They trace the car’s owner as a young mother, Carmen Thomas, who lives in Auckland and hasn’t been seen for several days. Her ex-partner, Brad Callaghan, says that she missed a scheduled pick up of their young son and that he is concerned for her well-being.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Nadia
programme.desc: At 7.30am on a mild, summer morning, a middle-aged woman goes into her backyard to unlock the self-contained unit where her 23-year-old daughter lives alone. She lets her daughter’s dog out and notices a pair of overalls lying on the floor, half-in, half-out of the bedroom. The overalls should be with her daughter who, by now, would normally be on her way to work at a recycling facility. The woman takes a closer look and finds her daughter’s body lying face-down on the bedroom floor, cold. She calls out to her husband, they phone emergency services and the operator tells them to roll over their daughter - her throat has - been cut.

programme.title: Jonah
programme.desc: An interview with a formerly enslaved African American man accompanies a powerful modern day dance vignette. The juxtaposition of past and present raises questions about inherited trauma and the possibility of regeneration. Directed by Andrew Michael Ellis.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. - For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. “Wildfire” patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety—as the wildfire grows within him—as he’s forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time. Directed by Andree Ljutica.

programme.title: Astor Place, The American Dream
programme.desc: Evolved through time, legendary multiethnic hair salon Astor Place has become a beacon of New York City cool. Its forty artists reveal answers to questions about the foundations of human existence. Their stories show the commitment of immigrants who came to America in pursuit of their dreams and still believe that there is light beyond the horizon. Directed by Giuseppe Malpasso.

programme.title: NF Forward: Teaqua & Jada
programme.desc: Jada Smoot is a lively, sweet 11-year-old just starting middle school who likes to swim, bike and spend time with her friends. Her mother, Teaqua, is starting a new job with United Airlines and enjoys reading. Both share the love of their close-knit family. Jada and Teaqua also share NF. With amazing spirit, Jada and Teaqua draw strength from each other to navigate these rocky waters.

programme.title: Bodega De Edgar
programme.desc: The courageous story of Edgar Torres immigrating to the US illegally with his father in the 80’s, becoming a wine expert and starting a winery in Paso Robles, CA to give his children a better future. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: The Heartbeat Of Life
programme.desc: In the sunlit hills of Sicily, artisan Francesco transforms goatskin into tambourines, each drum a reincarnation of life’s rhythm. Through his soulful craft, he gives voice to the cycle of life and death, calling his creations his children before releasing them into the world. Joined by Peppe, a passionate percussionist devoted to preserving Sicily’s ancestral beat, they weave a timeless narrative of tradition, connection, and the enduring heartbeat of the drum across generations. Directed by Guisseppe Malpasso.

programme.title: Still/Life

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.sub-title: Nature-Inspired Crafts: Wooden Rope Seat & Slab Wood Coffee Table
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

programme.desc: Avoiding the resorts and the all-inclusive vacation, Scott and Justin rent a car and head towards the tobacco fields around Viñales. They’re looking for a specific farmer to return a picture to him from a friend who visited years ago. After the successful search and a visit into the farmer’s home, they grab a couple of horses to ride into the countryside and try some sugarcane rum. On their way to Trinidad they pick up a hitchhiker, play a game of baseball with some kids, and are invited to take part in a traditional Santeria ceremony. But even the swinging machete, beating drums, sacrificed chicken, rum and cigars won’t end this trip. The three drive along the south east coast and visit Fidel Castro’s remote hideout on their way to Carnival in Santiago de Cuba.

programme.desc: From urban bustle to tranquil beaches, Taiwan has a soul and culture all its own. Creativity abounds in its people, not to mention the greatest vegan food in the world.

programme.title: In Search of Food
programme.sub-title: In Search Of Food S01 E03 - San Francisco NB
programme.desc: Fresh produce from the Farmers market, Hog Island Oyster Company's fresh oysters; the Mona Lisa cut of pork.

programme.title: On the Record With Mick Rock
programme.sub-title: On the Record with Mick Rock S01 E05 - Mark Ronson in New York NB
programme.desc: Mick Rocks visits with English musician and DJ Mark Ronson in New York City.

programme.title: On the Record With Mick Rock
programme.sub-title: On the Record with Mick Rock S01 E06 - Best of NB
programme.desc: Mick Rock revisits iconic moments with Josh Groban, Kings of Leon, Patti LaBelle, and Wayne Coyne. From school visits to art galleries, it's a journey through music, memory, and creativity. A vibrant look at the artists and cities that helped shape American sound and soul.

programme.title: Andiamo!UPTOWN
programme.sub-title: Andiamo! UPTOWN S01 E11 - Quebec City, Canada NB
programme.desc: Back to the snow Donna goes - but this time, she explores North America's oldest city and experiences local culture & cuisine as well as the city's most renowned hotel. PLUS - she'll visit the Ice Hotel!

programme.title: Andiamo!UPTOWN
programme.sub-title: Andiamo! UPTOWN S01 E12 - Ocho Rios, Jamaica NB
programme.desc: Donna visits Ocho Rios, Jamaica and will explore the history, amazing culture, adventure and an amazing family focused resort. She'll also highlight a wonderful Jam-Italian fusion restaurant that is a MUST when visiting Ocho Rios!

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S09 E03 - 48 Hours In Krakow NB
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and Joe Wilkinson explore Kraków’s quirky treasures—from medieval squares and salty mines to dumpling feasts, vodka tastings, and stained glass art—serving deadpan laughs with a side of cultural curiosity.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S09 E04 - 48 Hours In Madrid NB
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and Ellie Taylor race through Madrid’s museums, violet candies, ham-carving rituals, and surreal sermons—balancing art, history, and absurdity with deadpan charm, all under the searing Spanish sun and a swirl of cured pork.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E03 - India Part 3 NB
programme.desc: Gordon heads south to the coasts of Kerala for the ultimate seafood curry. In Tamil Nadu he hits a meat-free zone and faces his biggest culinary nightmare, living in an ashram where the only food on the menu is vegetarian. Any tranquillity soon evaporates when Gordon tries his highest-octane sport yet - bullock racing - before his final stop in the slums of Mumbai. There he cooks on Slumdog Millionaire streets before putting himself to the ultimate test, cooking alongside one of India's top chefs for a star-studded dinner at the Taj Hotel.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.sub-title: Epic Trails S03 E04 - Backpacking Québec, Part 1 NB
programme.desc: Backpacking along the Saguenay Fjord; a paddling adventure in Quebec's Laurentian Mountains.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.sub-title: Epic Trails S03 E05 - Backpacking Québec, Part 2 NB
programme.desc: Exploring coastal routes and nighttime wilderness adventures in the Eastern Township of Quebec.

programme.title: Race Across the World
programme.sub-title: Race Across The World S04 E04 - Episode 4 NB
programme.desc: In the bafta-winning, much loved series ‘Race Across the World’ five teams have been set the challenge to race 15,000 kilometres across East and Southeast Asia, passing through seven checkpoints. Without smartphones, internet access or bank cards, and armed only with the cash equivalent of the airfare to fly the route. Their skill, ingenuity and determination will be tested to the extreme as they navigate some of the world’s most populous regions and some of the most unexplored….

programme.title: DW Euromaxx At Its Best
programme.sub-title: Euromaxx At Its Best E18 - Germany In A Nutshell
programme.desc: Would you like to get to know Germany better? Then come along and find out what it means to work, study and get married in Germany.

programme.title: Art & the City
programme.sub-title: Art & The City S01 E05 - London NB
programme.desc: David Keeps explores London’s vibrant art scene from edgy Camberwell hotels and Tate Modern bridges to royal relics and Hoxton galleries uncovering creative contrasts in a city where ancient tradition and modern expression collide with wit.

programme.title: Art & the City
programme.sub-title: Art & The City S01 E06 - Los Angeles NB
programme.desc: David Keeps explores Los Angeles’s creative energy from cutting edge Culver City galleries and Disney Hall to the Getty’s bold exhibits and Chinatown’s emerging scene revealing how art, architecture, and personality fuel this sprawling cultural capital.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Avoiding the resorts and the all-inclusive vacation, Scott and Justin rent a car and head towards the tobacco fields around Viñales. They’re looking for a specific farmer to return a picture to him from a friend who visited years ago. After the successful search and a visit into the farmer’s home, they grab a couple of horses to ride into the countryside and try some sugarcane rum. On their way to Trinidad they pick up a hitchhiker, play a game of baseball with some kids, and are invited to take part in a traditional Santeria ceremony. But even the swinging machete, beating drums, sacrificed chicken, rum and cigars won’t end this trip. The three drive along the south east coast and visit Fidel Castro’s remote hideout on their way to Carnival in Santiago de Cuba.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S02 E06 - Mongolia - Tribes And Tribulations NB
programme.desc: After being separated at the airport and put on different flights, Scott arrives to find that his bag has gone missing. The guys grab supplies and climb into an old soviet van to start a long trek out to a Nomadic Reindeer tribe. But to get there, they will have to travel by van then by horseback for four days. Scott and Justin take part in the tribe’s traditional way of life and come to understand the necessity of the nature and balance around them.

programme.title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers
programme.sub-title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers S01 E05 - Dallas, TX NB
programme.desc: Matt and Ted Lee land in Dallas for a taste of barbecue that’s smoking the competition before sampling the best of Tex Mex, Mex-Mex and Czech-Mex flavors.

programme.title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers
programme.sub-title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers S01 E06 - New Orleans, LA NB
programme.desc: Matt and Ted Lee head to New Orleans where Creole and Vietnamese flavors merge, modern Israeli food finds a home and a historic cocktail culture gives rise to tasty hangover cures.

programme.title: Travel Guides: New Zealand
programme.sub-title: Travel Guides New Zealand S01 E03 - Gisborne NB
programme.desc: The Travel Guides head to the East Coast for a classic Kiwi road trip but how will the families fare in the cramped conditions of their campervans?

programme.title: Rock The Park
programme.sub-title: Rock The Park S04 E13 - Santa Fe National Forest NB
programme.desc: Jack and Colton meet up with up with friend and Forest Ranger Rourke McDermott to learn the skills necessary to survive in the New Mexico desert.

programme.desc: Cities by the sea are gateways to the world. They are all intrinsically defined by their position by the sea and consequently by an openness to the world, a spirit of discovery and a desire for adventure. The geo-strategic location of these cities has turned them into chess figures of changing political powers and systems, into transit locations of dreamers and migrants, and into melting pots of people from different backgrounds and cultures. And the endlessness of their offshore waters has always been a magnet for those with desires, dreams and visions. With the curious eyes of a stranger, the series wanders through a selection of the most interesting sea cities of the world and discovers their ways and idiosyncrasies, using the very latest aerial technologies and an opulent cinematic language.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: Join us on an epic adventure to a remote private island in Belize. As we spend our days catching lobsters, diving the worldclass reef and enjoying coconuts straight from the tree. We also learn about how much our tourism dollars really count.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The State of the Presidi and the Maremma
programme.desc: The State of the Presidi is a swampy, malarial land, which, thanks only to human resilience and intelligence, became a centre of wealth and culture. The journey starts from the Metalliferous Hills of Maremma, rich in raw metals and the historical capital of mining territory, and continues to the historical buildings and the ancient water springs of Massa Maratima with its famous Fertility Tree.

programme.title: The Colours of China
programme.desc: Five colours are an integral part of contemporary China and the ancient philosophy of Wu Xing. Each episode takes us to regions where we meet our characters, learn how Wu Xing sits in their lives and explore the landscapes they live in.

programme.title: A Long Weekend in... With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory O’Connell’s brand new series combines travel and cookery with the popular chef enjoying the culture as well as the cuisine of eight European cities – Palma de Mallorca, Vienna, Lisbon, Madrid, Bath, Nantes, Copenhagen and Edinburgh. Rory visits a different city in each episode, and while the primary focus is on food, Rory is a knowledgeable guide to so much more, with art and design being particular interests of his. Food becomes much more interesting when seen in context – the culture it is part of the landscape it’s produced in, the history that has influenced it. At the end of each episode, Rory makes a delicious dish with the local produce which he sources on his travels.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Explore the Bauhaus Legacy in Dessau, Germany. The Bauhaus is the 20th century’s most influential art, architecture, and design school that inspired a mindset and style known as Modernism. Join The Design Tourist Karen LeBlanc as she visits iconic Bauhaus Buildings earning Dessau a UNESCO World Heritage Site designation. The industrial city in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt holds the world’s largest collection of Bauhaus buildings. Much of the city’s Bauhaus architecture traces back to The Bauhaus School, which relocated to Dessau from Weimar in 1925.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Federico le explica a Alejandro, Vespasiano, Ángel y Sandra que él no mato a Matías. Federico habla a solas con Vespasiano y le cuenta toda la historia del niño y le pide ayuda con Vicenta. Alejandro interroga a Federico, el cual está muy preocupado por Vicenta que esta presa. Alejandro lo obliga a que le cuente todo lo sucedido. Christian habla con Abril para construir la clínica que tanto sueña. Él apura los trámites y coquetea a Abril. Yomaris y Vicenta hablan cosas en común y empiezan a amigarse. Rogelio interroga a Macarena, la cual le explica todo lo sucedido y afirma que ella no mato a Matías, pero Rogelio no le cree nada. Josué se entera gracias a África que la mujer carbonizada no es Pelusa y eso lo deja más tranquilo.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: En el entierro de Matías Macarena intenta clavarle una navaja a Inmaculada pero los guardaespaldas de la Baronesa la sacan. Mientras tanto Rogelio y África siguen investigando sobre la muerte de Matías y descubren que quien le dio los ansiolíticos y lo arrastró hasta la bañera fue la misma mujer. Christian se lleva a Abril para hablar con el arquitecto a un Restaurante, que es el mismo donde momentos más tardes aparecerá la Baronesa con sus amigos. En esta escena Abril ve a Alejandro llegar a la mesa de Inmaculada y observar como charlan. Minutos más tarde se encuentran Inmaculada y Abril en el baño del Restaurante y se miran despiadadamente, al salir la Baronesa le deja un papel a Abril, que ésta luego lo perdería en casa de Alejandro.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada confiesa a Vespasiano que Alejandro y ella son amantes. Por eso, el Jefe de la Unidad de Homicidios se siente decepcionado por el detective y decide alejarlo de las investigaciones por un tiempo. A su vez, Alejandro tiene problemas con su pareja, Abril, quien decide que lo mejor para ellos es alejarse por un tiempo. Simón cae en la mentira de Iris y se siente muy triste al enterarse que, supuestamente, el padre de su hija quiere recuperarla. Sin embargo, Iris no está dispuesta a seguir con la farsa y tiene intenciones de renunciar al plan. Ruth se ve obligada a ayudar a Pelugo, un prófugo que se supone que estuvo en la cárcel por un crimen que no cometió.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Matilde distraída en la peluquería no se da cuenta que se le ha pasado la hora de ir a buscar los morochos en la guardería y al ver la hora sale corriendo a la guardería para buscarlos., luego llega a su casa y no le dice a Gonzalo lo sucedido. Marco invita a Eglée a comer y no puede creer que esté tan feliz. Rómulo por su parte piensa que Eglée está fuera de sus cabales con la decisión que tiene de divorciarse pero que si lo viera con las maletas Eglée arrugaría. Gerson aparece en su casa, Gladis dentro de su rabia a la vez llora de alegria al ver que su hijo está bien. Dileidy siente ahora que tiene que agradecerle a Aureliano por hacer que Gerson regresara. Dileidy le agradece luego a éste, él la invita a salir. Ella acepta. Felicita le dice a Luis Fernando que la invite a salir, él acuerda con ella que lo espere en el lugar. Tatianita se alista para salir con Luis Fernando a pesar de que a su madre no le parece mucho porque es el novio de Felicita. Tatianita le aconseja a su madre pescar a un millonario con una pinta en un sitio de moda pidiendo un vaso de agua; La nena se escandaliza más todavía su situación. Luis Fernando está en un sitio nocturno con Tatianita y Santiago, Felicita está cerca en otro lugar cercano esperando a Luis Fernando, éste se ausenta de estar con Tatianita para acudir a la cita con Felicita. Tatianita ni se imagina que se ausenta de ella para estar con Felicita, lo mismo no se imagina Felicita pero con Tatianita. Mientras él está con Felicita no hace sino pensar en Dileidy, Dileidy quien en ese momento está con Aureliano no hace sino pensar en Luis Fernando. Cada uno desde donde están piensan por momentos en voz alta pensando que hablan con quienes tienes enfrente pero hablan es con sus propios pensamientos. Eglee le comenta a su hija que va a separarse de su padre, Cristinita le dice que lo intente para ella como hija sentirse bien, Eglée le comenta que pensaba tener apoyo aunque sea de su propia hija. Rómulo aparece con sus maletas y le dice que se va, Rómulo por momentos piensa que Eglée le dirá que no se vaya, pero cual es su sorpresa que Eglée le saca su cepillo de dientes y hasta le ayuda a arreglar la maleta y todo además de sugerirle que se vaya temprano al día siguiente porque es de noche ya. Gladis precisa a su hijo y lo insta a que se busque un trabajo y le pague cada centavo que le robó, que tenga dignidad y se mantenga él mismo así como a su propia familia. Dileidy le comenta a su madre que estaba con Aureliano, Gladis se preocupa ahora que siente que Dileidy sale con un pana de Gerson, dileidy le aclara que Gerson está en casa por aureliano y que a ella no le guste que salga con ningún hombre. Tatianita le dice a su madre que Luis Fernando sí ira en serio con ella, Felicita jura que Luis Fernando volvió con ella pero la verdad es que Luis Fernando le comenta a su amigo que solo sueña con dileidy. Yennilú le avisa a Dileidy que Luis Fernando está cerca, en la via, Dileidy se quita el uniforme rápidamente y se aleja de Yennilú, lo llama a él y se consiguen en la via se abrazan.

programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Chacorta que mató al Tostado, y aunque vengó a Victor, aún no ha terminado. Anuncia nuevos negocios con Venezuela y dice que comenzará a llamarse Danilo Ferro.

programme.desc: Elsa tiene que ceder para ayudar al Chema a escapar de prisión. Leonor tiene secretos insospechados, y planea usar a Ximena de carnada para atrapar a líderes del narcotráfico.

programme.desc: Roberto reclama que los Casillas lo usan para lavar dinero del narco y quiere salirse, pero ya es muy tarde. Leonor y Nevárez visitan al Chema en prisión y lo vinculan con Elsa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con Danilo Ferro y comienza a usar su identidad. Leonor registra el negocio de Matilde y hace que la arresten por todo el material importante que encuentra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Bigotes le dispara a Nevárez frente a su hija. Agonizando, Pedro ruega a Victoria que deje México, porque ya el país es muy peligroso. Matilde conoce a Elsa, y ambas son manipuladas por el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa cree tener el camino libre para ser gobernadora, pero Victoria anuncia su candidatura. Bigotes está herido, escapa de los hombres de Chema e intenta darle toda la información a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba sugiere a Matilde que visite al padre Lázaro en busca de ayuda espiritual, pero ella confiesa que Aurelio está vivo. Tijeras rechaza volver a la cárcel para ayudar a escapar a Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria recibe una carta seductora y se ilusiona, sin saber que detrás está Aurelio, quien le dona 5 millones de pesos a nombre de Danilo. Matilde promete a Guernica delatar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres de Chacorta descubren que el padre Lázaro iba a hablar con Garnica, y lo silencian; no dejan cabos sueltos. Por recuperar a su hijo, Matilde está decidida a entregar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A Matilde le tortura la idea de no volver a ver a su hijo, y el Chema le sugiere que lo secuestre. Leonor desconfía del suicidio del padre Lázaro: le pide a Garnica que presione a los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria y Danilo se besan, y ella no sospecha que se está enamorando de Aurelio Casillas. Ambos confiesan sentirse atraídos el uno por el otro. Mónica confirma su embarazo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa visita a Victoria y le propone una tregua para trabajar juntas contra el narcotráfico. Max está dispuesto a perder el juicio de Ximena para demostrar con quién está su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba es sometida a una cirugía, ha perdido mucha sangre y se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Aurelio sospecha que Matilde y el Chema están detrás. Ximena es condenada a prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio averigua quién es en verdad el escolta de Matilde, y le dice que se despida de su hijo. Los Casillas le declaran la guerra al Chema, y averiguan dónde se esconden sus hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde trata de reconciliarse con Chacorta, pero ya tiene los minutos contados: él no le perdona la traición. Lo importante ahora para los Casillas es hacer pagar al Chema.

programme.title: Historias de Amor en Sunflower Valley
programme.desc: Kate trabaja en un periódico de Seattle y su nuevo destino la lleva a su pueblo natal, Sunflower Valley. Su apuesto compañero de trabajo llega con ella y desentrañan una serie de enternecedoras historias de amor sobre la gente del pueblo.

programme.title: Inspirados Por El Amor
programme.desc: La tímida artista Isla se sorprende cuando su cuadro se vende accidentalmente al carismático vendedor Mark, cuyo jefe quiere encargarle una escultura. Mark, con la esperanza de impresionar a su jefe, convence a Isla y consigue que haga el trabajo, pero hay un problema... Isla nunca ha esculpido antes. Con el estímulo de Mark, la confianza de Isla florece y también su amor.

programme.title: Austentatious
programme.desc: Las amadas obras de Jane Austen se unen cuando Elinor, Marianne, Emma y Lizzie unen fuerzas como las mejores amigas del mundo de hoy.

programme.title: Luna de Miel para el Recuerdo
programme.desc: Cuando su prometido la abandona en el altar, Ava está decidida a disfrutar de su luna de miel sin él. Pasar un tiempo en un hermoso lugar la ayuda a descubrir lo que realmente quiere, pero cuando su prometido aparece, se siente más confundida que nunca.

programme.title: Mujercitas
programme.desc: Jo, una aspirante a escritora, se marcha a Nueva York decidida a publicar una novela, pero su editor la reta a escribir sobre algo más interesante: su familia. Cuando una tragedia lleva a las hermanas de vuelta a casa, permanecer unidas adquiere un nuevo significado. Mientras Jo consuela a su hermana enferma, Beth le pide una cosa: una historia.

programme.title: Encontrando El Amor en San Antonio
programme.desc: Adela recibe una oferta para trabajar en una nueva serie de una cadena que la hará viajar por Europa, pero le preocupa trasladar a Fabiola, su hija, que sigue añorando San Antonio.

programme.title: ¡Todos abordo por Amor!
programme.desc: Alison Marlowe tiene su vida planeada. Está cerrando la venta de la marina de su familia. Está tripulando un yate de 60 metros a través del Atlántico y comenzando su nueva y emocionante vida en lugares exóticos. Joel Cartwright, un hombre de negocios inteligente que se está tomando un descanso de la multinacional de su familia, quien quiere poner su viejo barco en el agua. Alison y Joel sienten una chispa instantánea, pero sus sentimientos pasan a un segundo plano mientras sus planes de vida la alejan de la ciudad.

programme.title: Cambio de Amor
programme.desc: En su decimotercer aniversario de boda, James y Michelle se despiertan y descubren que han cambiado de cuerpo. Incapaces de volver a intercambiarse, se ven obligados a comprender lo que el otro vive a diario.

programme.title: El Amor no Necesita Traducción
programme.desc: Julie Walters, estudiante de doctorado en lingüística, habla casi todos los idiomas imaginables. Es una gran creyente de que los idiomas se aprenden mejor haciendo actividades divertidas. Las cosas se ponen patas arriba para Julie cuando un empleado de un museo se pone en contacto con ella para que le dé clases de francés.

programme.title: Con Amor, Alaska
programme.desc: Cuando dos amigos de la infancia se reúnen gracias a una generosa herencia que otorga a sus corazones rotos mucho más de lo que esperaban: una segunda oportunidad para el amor.

programme.title: Relevo para un pistolero
programme.desc: Un desconocido de Boston ofrece a un notorio ex forajido de Arizona un trabajo que no puede rechazar.

programme.title: Winchester Uno Entre Mil
programme.desc: Winchester Uno Entre Mil El joven regresa a su ciudad natal diez años después de haber matado al asesino de sus padres. Una vez allí se le pide que ayude al sheriff.

programme.title: Duelo en el desfiladero
programme.desc: Un agente de la línea de escena investiga una serie de robos aceptando el trabajo de un ayudante de sheriff en un pueblo fronterizo de Arizona.

programme.title: A través del huracán
programme.desc: Tres vaqueros, confundidos con miembros de una banda de forajidos, son perseguidos implacablemente por un pelotón.

programme.title: La justicia del Coyote
programme.desc: Don César de Echagüe, haciéndose pasar por el vengador "El Coyote", continúa la lucha de las tropas americanas contra la injusticia y la perversión de la justicia contra la población hispana de California a mediados de la década de 1840.

programme.title: Jim Golden Poker
programme.desc: Djurado es un jugador profesional armado que llega a la pequeña ciudad de Silver Mine y gana la mitad del saloon local, la otra parte de la cual pertenece a Barbara, mientras lucha contra el notorio forajido Tucan.

programme.title: Le seguían llamando Trinidad
programme.desc: Le seguían llamando Trinidad - Bambino intenta enseñar a su hermano Trinity a convertirse en un forajido, pero los dos acaban salvando a una familia de pioneros y desarticulando una red de tráfico de armas.

programme.title: Sólo el valiente
programme.desc: Un despreciado comandante de caballería es injustamente culpado por su tropa de la muerte de un popular oficial y debe redimirse ante sus hombres durante un ataque indio al fuerte.

programme.title: El poni rojo
programme.desc: Un niño de rancho es dotado con un potro, crece para amarlo pero el potro se escapa, con resultados trágicos.

programme.title: Grito de Sangre Apache
programme.desc: Pandilla de vaqueros sádicos que no dejan que nada se interponga en su camino en búsqueda de oro.

programme.title: ¡Caray, qué palizas!
programme.desc: Durante la Guerra Civil, el cabo McDonald recibe un valioso cargamento de oro, que decide guardar para recuperarlo luego. Él es el único que conoce el lugar donde está enterrado, pero es asesinado. Ahora, un teniente de la Unión y los dos hijos de McDonald compiten para descubrir dónde se encuentra el oro escondido.

programme.title: Y dejaron de llamarle Camposanto
programme.desc: John y George McIntire son un par de ingenuos hermanos que viajan a un pueblo occidental sin ley para ver a su padre.

programme.title: Y en Nochebuena... ¡se armó el belén!
programme.desc: Dos hermanos que se odian se reúnen para pasar la Navidad con su madre, quien intenta unirlos. Enfrentados por viejos rencores y diferencias, tendrán que lidiar con sus sentimientos y conflictos familiares mientras su madre lucha por lograr lo que parece imposible: que sus hijos se reconcilien.

programme.title: Dos vivales en Fuerte Álamo
programme.desc: En plena Guerra Civil Americana, los soldados sicilianos Ciccio y Franco son encarcelados por deserción. Pero su destino da un giro inesperado cuando el ejército los recluta para una arriesgada misión de espionaje, confiando en que su torpeza aparente les permita engañar al enemigo. Una comedia bélica llena de enredos.

programme.title: La primera ametralladora del Oeste
programme.desc: Un hombre secuestra a la esposa de un comandante de caballería para intercambiarla por una pistola Gatling que está siendo vendida por un traficante de armas.

programme.title: Cheaters (60 minute Version)
